newsitem.title: UK: HORSE RACING-JOCKEY MCCOY IN FASTEST CENTURY.
newsitem.headline: HORSE RACING-JOCKEY MCCOY IN FASTEST CENTURY.

text.p: Tony McCoy etched his name in British jump racing's record books on Thursday when completing the fastest century of winners.
The champion reached the landmark when Class of Ninetytwo won the fifth race at Warwick.
He had moved on to 99 with the success of Dromhana in the previous race.
McCoy, 22, has beaten by 30 days the previous fastest century achieved by Peter Scudamore in 1988 and 1989.
The Ulsterman has been aided by the introduction of summer jumps racing which was not around in Scudamore's day. The season now starts on June 1.
McCoy only began riding in Britain two and a half years ago and his feat rounds off a remarkably rapid rise to the top.
He was champion for the first time last season and, barring injury, appears a certainty to retain his title at the end of the current campaign.
